A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the type bar) with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 January 2013 (the PDF was made on 16 April 2013).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-narrowescape-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Narrow Escape]]: The game text changes: “Cancel a battle” becomes “If opponent”; “battle” is added after “battle just initiated”; “any” becomes “you have a”; “is” is removed; “by moving” becomes “move”; “of” is added after “by moving all”; “characters” becomes “cards with ability”; “(at” becomes “(using their landspeed at”; “the Force).” becomes “Force) and cancel battle.”. The slip shows only the lower part of the card and adds a black strip below the text box with the title “Narrow Escape” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
